steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Delian League was founded in 478 BC as a defensive alliance against Persia, with Athens as leader (hegemon)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Member states contributed ships or money (phoros/tribute) stored on the island of Delos at the League's treasury

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Athens gradually transformed the League into an empire: moved the treasury to Athens (454 BC), forced members to use Athenian coinage and courts

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: States that tried to leave (e.g. Naxos, Thasos) were forcibly prevented; the League became an instrument of Athenian control
